extracted.name: Air Fryer Lemon Pepper Shrimp
extracted.description: These air fryer shrimp with lemon pepper are quick and easy to make. They can be served cold as an appetizer or as a delicious meal over rice or pasta.
ingredient_lines: 12 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Combine oil, lemon juice, lemon pepper, paprika, and garlic powder in a bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat.
Cook shrimp in the preheated air fryer until they are bright pink on the outside and the meat is opaque, about 6 to 8 minutes. Serve with lemon slices.
